name: BMTC electric bus fleet (PM E-DRIVE)
scope: 4,500 electric buses reported as 3,800 twelve-metre and 900 nine-metre (these reported counts do not sum to 4,500 — discrepancy in the source, not corrected here), 400 of them air-conditioned, procured under the central PM E-DRIVE scheme on a Gross Cost Contract model
pending: Rollout timeline, exact PM E-DRIVE central subsidy share for Bengaluru specifically, and depot development details not yet confirmed from a primary document. (A ₹4,391 cr subsidy figure is published for the scheme's national 9-city, 14,028-bus rollout — not a Bengaluru-specific figure, and not recorded here as this project's own subsidy amount.)
notes: First BMTC / buses record on this site. Corporation set to Central as a nominal placeholder only — this is a citywide fleet procurement, not tied to one corporation or set of wards. Cabinet approval date not confirmed from a primary document; the source's own publication date (2026-09-07) is used as the money_entry's as_of anchor instead.
